answer: Water is present in this scene, as confirmed by both SAR and optical analysis tools. The SAR tool (sar_read) identifies 9,287 water pixels, representing 14.17% of the scene, using a VV backscatter threshold of -16.0 dB. The optical tool (water_highlight) detects 12,386 water pixels, or 18.90% of the scene, using an Otsu-based RGB threshold. The two methods disagree on water extent, with an IoU of 0.137, indicating limited spatial agreement. The SAR water mask is calibrated and based on SDWI, while the optical mask is deterministic. Water is distributed across the scene, with higher concentrations likely in the central and southern sectors based on pixel density. The SDWI value mean is -14.125, which is consistent with water detection thresholds.
